C1685.title: PackAttack Chronicles Package Manager Attacks from 2017 to 2023
C1685.summary: The ecosyste-ms/typosquatting-dataset organizes known typosquatting malicious packages and their target mappings from public security research, and can be used to analyze typosquatting attacks in package manager ecosystems. Claims about the Karneades/PackAttack project, a 2017 to 2023 time range, and coverage of PyPI, npm, RubyGems, PowerShell Gallery, and other platforms should be supported with the PackAttack project page or dataset documentation.
